scope: First VACE flower-task LoRA training preflight
summary: The computational preflight passed, but metadata inspection exposed that the exact DiffSynth commit was not recorded; the attempt was retained and not used as sufficient provenance.
evidence: The run selected physical A800 GPU 1 with 81225 MiB free and validated the VACE checkpoint layout.
Post-run metadata inspection could not retrieve the expected DiffSynth commit field, exposing a provenance gap before training.
lessons: A passing GPU/model preflight is incomplete unless the exact trainer source revision and checkpoint hashes are persisted.
limitations: The metadata cannot uniquely identify the DiffSynth source used by this first preflight.
next_actions: Patch the trainer wrapper to record the DiffSynth commit, dataset hash, and checkpoint hashes, then rerun immutably.
